title: Graph fusion of incomplete clinical cohorts yields a bounded retrospective association
summary: Retrospective analyses report a specific graph association; the source notes albumin instability and imposed time direction. The association is not evidence of causation or an actionable clinical factor; transfer beyond the analyzed cohorts is not established.
ai_technology: A graph-fusion method combines incomplete clinical cohorts; a tabular foundation model is also examined for graph-guided prediction and steering.
